build.name: Build system
build.description: Build definitions, compiler integration, build-time SDK setup and packaging; excludes CI orchestration.

bootstrap.name: Bootstrap
bootstrap.description: Peer discovery, bootstrap sockets and initial rank exchange.

device-topology.name: Device detection and path building
device-topology.description: Device and link discovery, topology representation and communication path construction; excludes ring/tree graph search.

graph-search.name: Topology graph search
graph-search.description: Search for rings, trees and channel graphs over the detected topology.

transport.name: Transport build and connect
transport.description: Generic transport selection and rank connection setup, including P2P and SHM. Network-specific setup and data transfer belong to network.

tuning.name: Built-in collective tuning
tuning.description: Built-in bandwidth/latency models and algorithm/protocol tuning, such as src/graph/tuning.cc. Path-specific thresholds or kernel/CE choices for symmetric-memory collectives belong to symmetric.

communicator.name: Communicator lifecycle
communicator.description: Communicator split, shrink, revoke, resume, suspend and lifecycle management.

memory.name: Memory management
memory.description: General memory allocation, registration, mapping, ownership and release. Device API windows, device communicators and LSA semantics belong to device-api.

enqueue.name: Runtime kernel planning and enqueue
enqueue.description: Shared host-side work planning, enqueue, streams, groups and graph capture. Hardware launch policy belongs to dispatch, rank scheduling to scheduling, and symmetric-specific planning to symmetric.

dispatch.name: Kernel dispatch and CE masks
dispatch.description: Hardware kernel launch strategy and copy-engine mask selection. Built-in algorithm/protocol tuning belongs to tuning, and symmetric kernel/CE path selection to symmetric.

network.name: Network transport, plugin and proxy
network.description: Network backends, net-plugin interfaces, network transfers and proxy progress.

kernels.name: Native operations and device kernels
kernels.description: Built-in collective/P2P kernels, communication primitives and reductions; excludes extension, symmetric-memory and copy-engine kernels.

scheduling.name: AlltoAll and P2P scheduling
scheduling.description: Host-side AlltoAll/P2P rank pairing, communication rounds, batching and ordering. CE/DMA transfer partitioning belongs to copy-engine, and symmetric task planning to symmetric.

kernel-plugin.name: Kernel plugin and extension kernels
kernel-plugin.description: Extension-kernel interfaces, loading and externally supplied kernels.

tuner-plugin.name: Tuner plugin
tuner-plugin.description: Tuner-plugin ABI, loading and external tuning implementations.

profiler.name: Profiler and plugin
profiler.description: Profiling events, instrumentation, profiler plugins and inspector integration.

symmetric.name: Symmetric-memory collectives
symmetric.description: Symmetric-memory collective planning, kernels and synchronization, including host-side eligibility, kernel/CE path selection and thresholds within this path. Independently changed CE/DMA transfer execution belongs to copy-engine.

copy-engine.name: Copy-engine operations
copy-engine.description: Copy-engine/DMA execution of collective and P2P operations, including transfer batching, partitioning, queues, streams and synchronization. Kernel/CE path selection and thresholds for symmetric-memory collectives belong to symmetric.

ras.name: RAS and hang diagnostics
ras.description: RAS, hang monitoring, communicator dumps and related diagnostics.

device-api.name: Device API and LSA
device-api.description: Public device APIs, windows, local shared access and their implementation.

gin.name: GIN
gin.description: GPU/PPU-initiated networking, GIN APIs, plugins and GIN-specific RDMA backends; shared networking belongs to network.

workflow.name: Contribution and review workflows
workflow.description: Contribution guidance, issue/PR templates, review rules, reviewer routing, commit-message and merge automation, and their tests; includes supporting Actions triggers, gates and concurrency that preserve normal test behavior.

ci.name: Open-source test workflows
ci.description: Normal test selection, execution, runners, result reporting and pass/fail criteria; excludes contribution, review and merge automation and supporting Actions wiring that leaves normal test behavior unchanged.

other.name: Other changes
other.description: Changes outside the listed modules; explain the uncovered behavior explicitly.
